entries.text: Mayhap our dapper gentleman is ready?! Heyyy,\nMr. Walksabout! You good to go?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Here we go! The next stage for my totally rad\ntest! Everybody loves it—it’s the Pokémon Center![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Mr. Walksabout is once again hidin’ in the feed\nsomewheres! Panic! Ahhh! Find ’im quick![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Yesss! I knew you were somethin’ special!\c\nLet’s spice things up again before movin’ on to\nye olde next round![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: That’s right—iiit’s another Pokémon battle!\nGet out here, Poké Maniac pal![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Miss Iono’s watching! I can’t lose!

entries.text: There’s no stoppin’ ya! Master of seekin’ and\nmaster of battlin’! You’re the real deal!\r\nAllllll righty, then. Time for a change of scenery![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Ze last stage will be this place right here—\nthe battle court, where battles are a-ragin’![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Can you find our Mr. Walksabout among these\nrandos?! Let’s find out! Readyyy? GO![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: My, my. Admirably done.\c\nI hope you will find your treasure in your\nindependent study with just as much ease.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text:
Woo! My subscriber numbers are on the rise like
a super-fast Eelektross crawlin’ out of the ocean!\c
Err, I mean congratulations on passing my
Gym Test![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Hot diggity dang! What a good time, huh? You\nhad people on the edge of their seats worldwide![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Nope, nope! Get your eyes checked, friendo!\nThat’s not Mr. Walksabout![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.text: Would you like to try your hand at our Gym Test\nand appear on Iono’s stream again?

entries.text: But don’t let that get ya down!\c\nFind Mr. Walksabout in all his hiding places this\ntime! You can dooo eeet![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
